test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) WD-BK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3f6293a916bffdbb7db52f9a148374fc97668208262deefa581be17fa41528a.png] 

Option 2) GN-LU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f505058415b125dcb5d94a93218d709e3b4643c0ecaa3040012164aa3540cd35.png] 

**Option 3) FN-KT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/769ae6b00073a3b9fcd1744deb3439b171d80bb06bab6dcd444a98f492ebcff9.png] 

Option 4) JQ-OX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0ddda4fb36c8c949fe658d401ccbc29248953ef00a9976efdbef346d301a90d.png] 

Here, 'FN-KT' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
